title: Villager Link
description: This mod adds an easy way to see which villagers take which beds and work stations when trading with them!
body:
# **🏡 Villager Link**

Which villager claimed your lectern? Which one is sleeping in THAT bed? Find out instantly.
Villager Link is a simple but essential utility mod for anyone who has ever lost their mind trying to figure out why their villagers won't restock, won't breed, or just refuse to cooperate. Press U to toggle the Villager Tracer and instantly reveal the invisible links between every villager, their bed, and their job site block - all wrapped in colour-coded bounding boxes so you can see exactly who owns what.

## **🔍 Info To Know**

- Each villager gets their own unique colour that highlights:
- Themselves — never lose track of who's who in a crowded trading hall!
- Their claimed bed - spot double-claimed or orphaned beds immediately!
- Their job site block - confirm your librarian is on their lectern, your butcher on their smoker, your cleric on their brewing stand, and so on!

## 😤 You Need This

No more breaking and replacing workstations hoping for the best. No more standing there wondering why your carefully built breeder isn't working. One keypress and the answer is right in front of you - whether it's a villager that's claimed a bed two chunks away, or two villagers fighting over the same workstation.

## **⚙️ Features**

- 🟡 Colour-coded outlines per villager, bed, and job site block!
- ⌨️ Fully rebindable toggle (default: U)!
- 💬 On-screen confirmation when toggling!
- 🪶 Zero performance impact when off or on!



**Press U. See the truth. Fix your villagers.**
